positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Helping fashion sellers offer the best online experience powered by FB/IG Shops to discover & buy apparel products people love and keep.
----------------------------------------------
Happy to announce that Presize has now joined Meta.

It has been one heck of a rollercoaster ride starting with 3 people, and growing to 50 employees with 100M+ size recommendations generated using our product. As we were sitting in Meta’s European HQ in London (picture on the right), it struck me… Who would have thought it leads to exiting to a company where we can continue to work on our technology/vision and impact the life of 3.6bn users? 

We will keep helping users to find the right size when buying fashion online which ultimately also benefits small businesses and our planet 🌱

My role is Engineering Manager of the Fashion Team (which includes former Presizers and both of my co-founders) at Meta. As a product team we are responsible for helping connect fashion businesses with customers on Facebook and Instagram. The IG/FB Shops experience is already rolled out in the US.

positions.title: Founder & CTO
positions.description:
Presize has joined Meta in April 2022. Presize was a VC-backed AI startup with 50 employees, >1m users, 50 b2b customers, grew from 0 to 6 digit MRR in one year.

Product: The most accurate body measurements form one turn in front of a smartphone and/or answering a few questions about your body shape. Size recommendations for shoppers in Fashion eCommerce that people trust (higher conversion) & keep (less returns & CO2 emissions).
